Name: Sailor Moon Hairstyles Clothing and Kimono
Author: bblueberry
Description:
[center][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/DfFUhzn.png[/img][size=4]

1.   Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿,
﻿2.  Download [b]Sailor Styles[/b] and add it to your [b]Mods[/b] folder,
﻿3.  Visit Artemis at the [b]Hat Mouse House [/b]on [b]Sundays and Mondays [/b]to see what's on sale!

[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ztZGQmY.png[/img]

Artemis' shop just went premium. Where did he even get these?
Dress casual or ceremonial with paired clothes from the Hakama and Yukata Collections.
One size fits all. Premium price. Styles for all occasions.

[/size][size=2](added 2025)[/size][size=3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LzEGECM.png[/img]

Look what the cat dragged in. A slick new line of menswear.
Pick from a dozen three-piece Tuxedo Mask fits, or take a jog in Mamoru's '90s streetwear.
As ever, pick them up from Artemis' shop – motorbike and mysterious aura not included.

[/size][size=2](added 2023)[/size][size=3]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/3WZYkxK.png[/img]

Artemis sells a selection of colourful kimono all year round, including a plain dyeable variety.
Recently redesigned and redrawn. Relisted for resale.
Tailored for both male and female fits.

[/size][size=2](added 2021)[/size][size=3]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/tyuhvH2.png[/img]

Pay a visit to the Hat Mouse House to see what Artemis has for sale!
Pick your favourite outfits from the show, made to match the Stardew Valley style.
Also comes with a handful of hair bows, some costume masks, and a new pleated sailor skirt.
Some matching coloured skirts are stocked to match certain dress tops.
All clothing comes in both male and female fits.

[/size][size=2](added 2020)[/size][size=3]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/EVEkzlo.png[/img]

Choose from a range of new hairstyles from all the inner and outer sailors!
Comes in both original-colour and custom-colour styles.
For the original-colour styles, use Saturation 0 and Lightness 99.
Pick your style from the character creator, the Wizard's magic mirror, or a mod menu of your choice.

[/size][size=2](added 2019)[/size][size=3]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/2usVnlr.png[/img]

contact me via the Stardew Valley Discord, or publish your translation files yourself if you prefer.
